question: Does the exact duration beneath the canonical prior-60 resistance distinguish subsequent opportunity and false-breakout behavior?
mechanism: More sessions since the most recent canonical reference close permit more supply turnover beneath resistance; after controlling base depth and current positioning, older references should precede greater MFE and fewer false breakouts.

feature_provenance.source: outcome-blind formation artifact frozen by EXP-OBL-003
feature_provenance.role_in_rejected_taxonomy: context only; not a lineage-assignment axis

population.qualification: Accepted completed-entry population is historically outcome-consumed and bounded PIT-B; CY-011 is not used.

primary_predictor.name: sessions_since_reference
primary_predictor.definition: integer session distance from signal t to the latest occurrence of the maximum adjusted close in t-60..t-1
primary_predictor.form: continuous ordinal Spearman/rank treatment; no bins, thresholds, or transformations selected from outcomes

mfe.definition: accepted continuous maximum favorable excursion over the actual frozen holding path

non_false_breakout.definition: one minus the accepted false_breakout indicator, where false breakout is MFE<10% and terminal return<=0

primary_metrics.controlled: partial rank association after fixed controls and entry-year effects
primary_metrics.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg over exactly the two raw primary endpoint p-values

controls_interpretation: Entry box width represents base depth; prebreakout distance and signal breakout margin separate elapsed turnover time from current position and breakout displacement. Breadth remains a frozen control only.

falsification.temporal: LOYO and three frozen baseline blocks
falsification.post_entry_conditioning: add actual holding duration and canonical exit-reason dummies only as a sensitivity attack, never as a causal control
falsification.timing: reference age is known at completed signal close and can inform T+1 or later only
falsification.right_tail: terminal/right-tail summaries cannot rescue a failed primary gate

decision.VALIDATE: both primary endpoints pass raw, controlled, temporal, and falsification gates
decision.SUPPORTED_WEAK: both pass raw, controlled, and temporal gates but falsification fails
decision.REFINE: exactly one primary endpoint passes raw and controlled magnitude gates
decision.REJECTED: neither primary endpoint passes raw and controlled magnitude gates

interpretation_boundary.potential_action_timestamp: entry execution T+1 open or later
forbidden: choosing a sign after outcome inspection
entry, exit, sizing, overlay, or production rule
